raw_comment:
I noticed that there is a line of severe drought almost in a band horizontally across the country, also one vertically down the middle of the country. 
Drought doesn't seem to be connected to a type of geography, save for the fact that Florida has no drought , presumably because it has had such intense storms lately. I wonder why GA and SC, which also got a ton of rain in the more recent storms, are nonetheless abnormally dryi don’t think that makes a lot of sense. I also why there is so much drought and abnormal dryness everywhere .I live in New York which had fires and the drought was only moderate so that’s not. very good title : Abnormal droughts
